model_flags.translation: If I give you my WhatsApp number, I will give it to my mother. We can talk on WhatsApp.
model_flags.excerpt: kas kudu na ammalukku na idhala pondra na whatsapp la number tharanam. nam whatsapp la besikalam.

model_flags.translation: If you come here, one hour of talk will cost 100 rupees. I will charge 200 rupees if you want to talk.
model_flags.excerpt: idhala vanna pona oru manaram besana 100 rupadam varum. enakku andhneri 200 rupadam enak kudu na adhala pesalam.
